scope: publicly documented Claude Code auto-memory and hook surface; no local Claude Code runtime execution

sources.claim: Auto memory persists per-project notes across sessions; MEMORY.md is loaded at session start; topic files load on demand; files with YAML frontmatter receive a modified timestamp when Claude writes them.
PreToolUse hooks can block tool calls; lifecycle hooks expose session and compaction seams.
The persistence-layer issue was closed as completed, with specific gaps invited as separate issues.

notes: A modified timestamp is a freshness hint, not a source identity, lineage edge, applicability verdict, or action authority token.

Generic PreToolUse hooks provide an extension point for an external verifier, but the documented auto-memory surface does not itself expose the provenance/state-binding fields required by FRI-1 or FRI-5.
Missing documentation is classified as NOT_OBSERVABLE, not FAIL.
